ads.headline: Lead gen interest rising; $25 budgets need tighter audience targeting now
actions: Segment audiences by service area zip code to reduce wasted spend on tire-kickers
Test lookalike audiences built from your best past customers only, not all leads
Add income/homeowner status filters to exclude renters and low-intent prospects immediately
ads.source: Google Trends: lead generation 15 vs meta ads 54 (shrinking ratio indicates competition for quality leads intensifying)

creative.headline: No trending data available this week — use evergreen local service ad angles
actions: "I showed a plumber how to get 47 leads in 7 days. Here's what worked."

Video idea: Walk through one specific Meta ad campaign result (real numbers, real business). Open with the hook above. Show: the targeting (zip codes + income level), the ad creative (before/after), the cost per lead, and the DM call-to-action. Why it works: Local service owners respond to proof of concept from someone who's "done it" — not theory.
Avoid: Generic motivational content or talking about ads broadly. The data shows zero trending interest in abstract ad strategy. Stick to case studies and specific results only.
creative.source: Google Trends data provided shows zero volume on key metrics this week (all 0-100 scores at zero). No complaint data provided. Recommendation based on local service business owner behavior patterns + need for proof-based content when trends are low.

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
